title: Characterization of successful pair scans
statement: For an initial remembered bit $\ell\in\{\mathrm{none},0,1\}$ and Boolean words $z,w$, the pair scan started with $\ell$ returns $w$ exactly when there is a Boolean word $u$ such that $z=u_0u_0u_1u_1\cdots u_{n-1}u_{n-1}\,01w$ and the last bit of $u$, if present, or otherwise $\ell$, is not $0$.
